basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Parkside, this charming and updated home blends timeless character with modern comfort. Thoughtful details include refinished hardwood floors, intricate woodwork, and fresh interior/exterior paint. A sunlit living room with vintage tiled fireplace and original built-ins flows into a formal dining room through glass French doors. The remodeled kitchen (with permits) features sleek new appliances, flooring, cabinets, counters, and a flex space ideal for a home office. Two spacious bedrooms overlook a lush backyard, paired with a refreshed split bath. Downstairs offers a bonus space with wet bar, additional bedroom, bath, and separate entrance perfect for guests or extended living. The tiered backyard provides private patio areas and mature landscaping. The 1-car garage includes utility sink, a built-in workstation, and abundant storage. Just a block to Taraval shops, and transit, plus easy access to parks, Muni L-Line, and 19th Ave for effortless city living.
